cases.title: Verify that a Site Content Author is denied access to search configuration (EN)

steps.action: Log into Liferay CMS as Site Content Author (EN locale)
steps.expected: Login succeeds as Site Content Author

steps.action: Navigate/attempt to navigate to the Global Search configuration screen
steps.expected: Access is blocked with message 'Access Denied.'; configuration screen is not opened or fields are not editable

steps.action: Attempt to change a configuration value and save
steps.expected: Save action is not available/executed; no configuration is changed

cases.title: Verify that saving search configuration displays the EN success toast

steps.action: Log into Liferay CMS as Administrator (EN locale)
steps.expected: Login succeeds

steps.action: Navigate to the Global Search configuration screen
steps.expected: Configuration screen loads with current values
Value 15 entered in Results Per Page
Toast 'Your request completed successfully.' is displayed; configuration is persisted (value 15 shown on reload)

cases.title: Verify that all search configuration changes are recorded in the audit log

steps.expected: Login succeeds

steps.action: Change Results Per Page from 10 to 20 and save
steps.expected: Configuration saved, toast shown

steps.action: Navigate to the Audit Log module
steps.expected: Audit Log module loads

steps.action: Locate the most recent entry for this configuration change
steps.expected: A new entry is present showing the acting Administrator, 'Results Per Page' changed from 10 to 20, and a timestamp matching the save action

cases.title: Verify that a valid Results Per Page value is accepted and saved

steps.action: Navigate to Global Search configuration as Administrator
steps.expected: Configuration screen visible with current value
Value 20 entered
Save succeeds; toast shown; value 20 is persisted

cases.title: Verify that an empty Results Per Page value is rejected

steps.expected: Configuration screen visible with current value

steps.action: Clear the Results Per Page field
steps.expected: Field is empty
Validation error shown ('Results Per Page is required'); save is blocked; previous value is retained

cases.title: Verify that a Results Per Page value of zero is rejected

steps.expected: Configuration screen visible with current value
Value 0 entered
Validation error shown ('must be a positive integer'); save is blocked; previous value is retained

cases.title: Verify that a negative Results Per Page value is rejected

steps.expected: Configuration screen visible with current value
Value -5 entered
Validation error shown ('must be a positive integer'); save is blocked; previous value is retained

cases.title: Verify that a non-numeric Results Per Page value is rejected

steps.expected: Configuration screen visible with current value
Value 'abc' entered (or field rejects non-numeric input on keystroke)
Validation error shown ('must be a numeric value'); save is blocked; previous value is retained

cases.title: Verify that a saved Results Per Page value persists after reload

steps.expected: Configuration screen loads

steps.action: Enter 25 in Results Per Page and click Save
steps.expected: Save succeeds; toast shown
Results Per Page still shows 25 after reload

cases.title: Verify that the administrator can define Indexed Content Types and they take effect

steps.expected: Configuration screen loads

steps.action: Select Pages, Events, Publications, and Services in Indexed Content Types
steps.expected: All four values selected
Save succeeds; selection persisted

steps.action: Search a keyword known to match each of the four types
steps.expected: Public search continues to return matches for all four content types

cases.title: Verify that Indexed Content Types cannot be saved empty

steps.expected: Configuration screen loads with current selections

steps.action: Deselect all values in Indexed Content Types
steps.expected: All values deselected
Validation error shown ('at least one content type is required'); save is blocked; previous selection retained

cases.title: Verify that the administrator can define Available Filters and they take effect on the results page

steps.expected: Configuration screen loads

steps.action: Select Type, Category, and Date Range in Available Filters
steps.expected: All three values selected
Save succeeds; selection persisted

steps.action: Search a keyword on the public site and inspect the filters panel
steps.expected: Results page shows Type, Category, and Date Range filter controls

cases.title: Verify that Available Filters cannot be saved empty

steps.expected: Configuration screen loads with current selections

steps.action: Deselect all values in Available Filters
steps.expected: All values deselected
Validation error shown ('at least one filter is required'); save is blocked; previous selection retained

cases.title: Verify that a valid Re-index Schedule is accepted and saved

steps.expected: Configuration screen loads
Schedule value entered
Save succeeds; toast shown; schedule value persisted

cases.title: Verify that an invalid Re-index Schedule value is rejected

steps.expected: Configuration screen loads
Invalid value entered
Validation error shown ('invalid schedule format'); save is blocked; previous schedule value retained

cases.title: Verify that the administrator can manually trigger a re-index

steps.action: Navigate to Global Search configuration as Administrator
steps.expected: Configuration screen loads
Re-index job starts; a running/in-progress indicator is shown

steps.action: Wait for the job to complete
steps.expected: Job completes; a completion indicator/timestamp is shown

cases.title: Verify that re-indexing a large dataset does not block the public search experience

steps.action: As Administrator, trigger a full re-index (large dataset)
steps.expected: Re-index job starts and shows an in-progress indicator

steps.action: While re-indexing is in progress, as a Public Visitor in a separate browser context search keyword 'events'
steps.expected: Public search returns results normally within the standard response time, with no error, timeout, or maintenance/blocking message shown, while the re-index job is still running

cases.title: Verify that adding a new content type becomes filterable once indexed

steps.action: Confirm 'Circulars' is not currently a selectable Content Type filter value on the public results page
steps.expected: 'Circulars' is absent from the filter option list

steps.action: As Administrator, add 'Circulars' to Indexed Content Types and save
steps.expected: New content type is added and saved in configuration
Re-index job completes

steps.action: Search a keyword and inspect the Content Type filter options
steps.expected: 'Circulars' now appears as a selectable Content Type filter value, and selecting it returns Circulars-type results

steps.expected: تسجيل الدخول ينجح كـSite Content Author

steps.action: محاولة الانتقال إلى شاشة إعدادات البحث العام
steps.expected: يُرفض الوصول برسالة 'تم رفض الوصول.'؛ لا تُفتح شاشة الإعدادات أو تكون الحقول غير قابلة للتعديل
لا يتوفر/ينفَّذ إجراء الحفظ؛ لا يتغير أي إعداد

steps.expected: تسجيل الدخول ينجح

steps.action: الانتقال إلى شاشة إعدادات البحث العام
steps.expected: تُحمَّل شاشة الإعدادات بالقيم الحالية

steps.action: تعيين عدد النتائج لكل صفحة إلى 15

تظهر رسالة 'تمت معالجة طلبك بنجاح.'؛ يتم حفظ الإعداد (تظهر القيمة 15 بعد إعادة التحميل)
